PR136-GPS-ICONS-SCROLL-20261103
# LAB-only firmware based exactly on PR136 head 69da67a35ebfb5717e395d4b2a0f53d55dae4b01.
# Includes swipe-scroll Settings -> System -> Diagnostics, with fixed Back.
# Includes accessible System Properties -> Board GNSS status.
# GPS icon appears to left of SD after checksum-valid UBX/NMEA packets:
#   amber while connected without fresh fix, green when FIX, absent >5s
#   without valid packets. GPIO35 UART2 at 115200 unchanged.
# Settings -> System: independent Wi-Fi, SD and GPS icon ON/OFF stored in NVS.
# Test both CYD 2.8 ST7789 and 3.2 ST7798, portrait/landscape,
# GNSS acquisition and stale state, icon hide/show/reboot, scroll, SD, BLE,
# Wi-Fi, SquachMesh. No production release, merge or version tag.
